goal: Add GitHub-hosted Windows native CI smoke.
description: Keep local-ci-gate running a windows-latest x64 native CMake build smoke so Windows build regressions are visible while the port is still converging.

acceptance_criteria.text: local-ci-gate has a windows-latest job that attempts a native x64 CMake build.
Docs state that Windows CI is non-blocking until native Windows support closes.

goal: Make source-build and external tool discovery portable on Windows.
description: Move PATH splitting, executable lookup, TTY checks, source-build compiler output paths, git/cmake invocation, and PATHEXT handling behind current helpers so source-build mode and external compiler discovery work on Windows without POSIX-only assumptions.

acceptance_criteria.text: Source-build mode can locate git, cmake, ninja or the selected generator, and the produced styio executable on Windows.
External tool lookup honors Windows PATH separators and executable suffixes while preserving Linux and macOS behavior.
Windows tests cover binary-mode discovery and source-build path construction without requiring POSIX shell semantics.

goal: Make the native package-manager core build and test on Windows x86_64.
description: Implement the Windows native process backend, environment handling, timeout behavior, stdout/stderr capture, working-directory handling, and process termination semantics needed by spio commands and tests.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Windows x86_64 machine builds spio with CMake and runs the native test suite with SPIO_BUILD_TESTS=ON.
Process execution tests cover stdout, stderr, stdin, environment overrides, working directory, timeout, nonzero exit, and command lookup on Windows.
Linux and macOS process execution tests still pass after introducing the Windows backend.

commit.message: Adapt native core for Windows x86

goal: Add Windows x86_64 installer and managed styio validation.
description: Add a first-class Windows installer path, windows-x86_64 release lookup, checksum verification, spio.exe installation, styio.exe managed install, and launcher behavior without POSIX shell requirements.

acceptance_criteria.text: Windows installer installs spio.exe and configures the managed styio.exe path without requiring POSIX shell semantics.
Windows release lookup downloads spio.exe and styio.exe from the documented tools/spio and tools/styio-windows-cli namespaces and verifies SHA-256 sidecars.
Windows installer tests cover install directory selection, PATH guidance, SPIO_HOME release-root config, and launcher behavior.

commit.target: installer, tool install, docs, and Windows evidence

goal: Prove Windows x86_64 real-machine workflow support.
description: Run build, native tests, installer, spio doctor, managed styio install, styio --version, and clean project workflow smoke on a Windows amd64 machine, then record evidence using the platform template.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Windows x86_64 machine records build, test, install, doctor, managed styio, and workflow smoke evidence.
Windows evidence includes PowerShell version, Visual Studio or Build Tools version, CMake generator, installed paths, PATH guidance, and managed styio current path.

goal: Close Windows artifact, support, and CI evidence.
description: Publish or verify Windows spio.exe and managed styio.exe artifacts, then remove non-blocking CI status once Windows evidence is complete.

acceptance_criteria.text: windows-x86_64 has release artifacts or is explicitly excluded from public support claims.
Windows release evidence uses the shared platform evidence template and records artifact URLs, checksums, installed paths, and launcher behavior.
Windows CI no longer uses continue-on-error after native build, tests, installer, and workflow evidence are complete.

commit.target: Windows release docs, package roots, CI, and evidence records
